tools.name: search_compounds
tools.description:
Find compounds on SharpSyn by name, synonym, CAS number, InChIKey or
    molecular formula. Returns name, CAS, InChIKey, page URL and a summary of
    suppliers, price and carbon footprint for each match, best matches first.

tools.name: get_compound
tools.description:
Everything SharpSyn publishes about one compound, given its CAS number,
    InChIKey or name: identifiers, structure (SMILES, InChI), number of verified
    suppliers with regions, grades and lead times, price range per kg with its
    confidence label and data date, the cradle-to-gate carbon footpr

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description:
Suppliers listed publicly on SharpSyn (companies that asked to be listed),
    optionally only those in one country or offering one compound (CAS, InChIKey
    or name). Returns company name, country, website, number of public listings
    and the profile URL.

tools.name: request_quote_link
tools.description:
A link the user opens to ask SharpSyn's suppliers for a quote on a
    compound (CAS number, InChIKey or name). Nothing is sent by calling this:
    the user fills in quantities and sends the request themselves.
